decision_title: Prefer ccf/cxf harness ids over raw claude/codex on this fleet
decision_reason: ccf/cxf are zsh wrappers that inject flownet Anthropic/Codex env; raw claude/codex fail honestly on missing auth. Adapters share argv with claude/codex but expect that env — document and smoke those ids as the fleet path.
summary: Decision: Prefer ccf/cxf harness ids over raw claude/codex on this fleet

decision_reason: opencode defaults can route through flownet; setting MAYFLY_OPENCODE_MODEL (e.g. opencode/big-pickle) keeps smoke and local hatches on OpenCode-native providers without hardcoding a model in the task schema.
summary: Decision: OpenCode model via MAYFLY_OPENCODE_MODEL env

rejected_alternatives.option: require model in every task JSON
